title.narrative: Round 10 Tuberculosis proposal consolidated with Round 8 - Bangladesh (01-Jul-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Bangladesh, Tuberculosis, Economic Relations Division, Ministry of Finance of the People's Republic of Bangladesh (MOF Bangladesh)This program has the following goals: The goal of Concept note is to reduction of the TB prevalence by 6% by 2017, based on a baseline determined in the prevalence survey to be conducted in 2014. The objectives of this program are: Ensure access to DST for 75% of retreatment cases by 2017; treat 100% of detected MDR-TB cases and achieve a treatment success rate of at least 75% in detected MDR-TB cases. Ensure adequate support for operational research to foster innovation. Ensure that 100% of TB service facilities receive regular supervision and monitoring, and produce timely and accurate reports, by 2016. Ensure that at least 60% of required staff positions identified in a revised national human resource development plan are filled, and 100% of all filled positions are trained, by 2017. Ensure the long-term availability of 100% of required funding for activities at all program levels through effective planning and partner coordination; maintain GOB contribution greater than 10% of total TB budget. Increase annual case detection of all forms of TB to 193,687 by 2017 (from baseline of 184,507 in 2013, NTP MIS). Maintain a treatment success rate of at least 92% in all forms of detected non-MDR TB cases and ensure quality-controlled treatment services at all implementation sites. Strengthen engagement of all public and private care providers

PSM- Other 1: Percentage of joint monitoring visits according to supervision plan done
Percentage of notified TB cases, all forms, contributed by non-NTP providers - public sector
Percentage of TB patients who had an HIV test result recorded in the TB register

Percentage of notified TB cases, all forms, contributed by non-NTP providers - community referrals
Number of cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Number of TB cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
Number of notified cases of bacteriologically confirmed TB, new and relapses
MDR-TB- Other 1: Percentage of MDR-TB cases who completed treatment successfully

Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of TB cases, all forms, bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all TB cases registered for treatment during a specified period, new and relapse cases
Percentage of bacteriologically confirmed TB cases successfully treated (cured plus completed treatment) among the bacteriologically confirmed TB cases registered during a specified period

Percentage of laboratories showing adequate performance in external quality assurance for smear microscopy among the total number of laboratories that undertake smear microscopy during the reporting period
Percentage of previously treated TB patients receiving DST (bacteriologically positive cases only)
Percentage of HMIS or other routine reporting units submitting timely reports according to national guidelines
Percentage of reporting units reporting no stock-outs of anti-TB drugs on the last day of the quarter
